mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `order` (buyer_id, seller_id, total_amount, status) VALUES (#{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, o.buyer_id, o.seller_id, o.total_amount, o.status, o.create_time, o.pay_time, b.book_id, b.title AS book_title, bu.username AS buyer_name, su.username AS seller_name FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN book b ON oi.book_id = b.book_id LEFT JOIN `user` bu ON o.buyer_id = bu.user_id LEFT JOIN `user` su ON o.seller_id = su.user_id WHERE o.buyer_id = #{buyerId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
